# Open adaptive loops, assume-guarantee joint viability, the coupled race, and adaptive collapse

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`coupled-adaptive-loops-and-race` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](coupled-adaptive-loops-and-race.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Open adaptive agents compose as black boxes over coupled substrates when warning margin exceeds draw times alarm lag; when discovery, pool silence, post-turn drawers, and lag compete, viability turns on their race; unread adapting loops collapse jointly while bidirectional adaptation holds.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. Open adaptive loop interface and opaque assume-guarantee composition: OpenLoop processes disturbances under state-independent admissibility (Viability.disturbed), carrying observation-triggered alarms (emitAlarm), silence loads, pre-countdown/post-countdown draw bounds, and bounded countdown lag eta ≤ maxLag inside LoopCertificate. Under pooled site monitoring, an observation-driven channel blind to raw substrate stock st.1, monotone rising coupled dynamics (Coupled.Indexed.Rises Drawn.whole), post-turn threshold viability, and warning buffer x_crit + (globalMaxLag + 1) * preTotal ≤ warnLevel plus initial buffer x_crit + maxEta init * preTotal ≤ x_0, assume_guarantee_joint_viable proves joint Viability.Certificate (and assume_guarantee_joint_kernel proves Viability.Kernel) without unfolding (L i).next or (certs i).K. 2. Coupled Race Theorem: inside raceStep, alarm gating directly evaluates five-member pool majority (SelectionPool.Web.holdsCount / MajorityHolds, silenced at K_silence ≤ loss by SelectionPool.Web.majority_outvoted) and post-turn drawdown embeds two-drawer coordination on CoupledDrawers.Optimum.Coupled.AtOnce.Shores.shore 1 (H_coord = 1 ≤ 1 vs any Perfect uncoordinated profile H_uncoord = 2 via Shores.drain_perfect). Across identical start stock 13 and critical floor 5, WitnessGood survives from step 4 onward, while WitnessNoDiscovery (probeAt = none), WitnessSilenced (probeAt = some 2 after watcher loss reaches 2), WitnessUncoordinated (post-turn drain = 2), and WitnessTooSlow (ruleLag = 2) each collapse to 0. 3. Joint collapse of unread adapting loops: under monotone substrate giving gSub and unread local shares (ClosedCapture.unread_course), when combined rule-dependent draws exceed H_joint while solo draws stay within solo viability, unread_adaptive_joint_collapse transfers RegimeMargin failure onto the joint substrate. <a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. For assume_guarantee_joint_viable: finite lists sites and agents, full site coverage, state-independent admissibility on OpenLoop.process, blind channel firing within maxSilence, monotone Coupled.Indexed.Rises Drawn.whole dynamics, post-turn threshold viability at x_crit, and warning buffer x_crit + (globalMaxLag + 1) * preTotal ≤ warnLevel plus initial slack x_crit + maxEta init * preTotal ≤ x_0.
- For unread_adaptive_joint_collapse: monotone substrate giving gSub, unread local shares, and joint draw floor H_joint ≤ jointDraw.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- That real-world AI training, evaluation, or multi-agent deployment loops meet LoopCertificate lag bounds, monotone Coupled.Indexed dynamics, or deterministic Nat resource arithmetic without empirical calibration.
- Optimality or performance within the safe region: assume_guarantee_joint_viable certifies invariant safety above x_crit, not capability maximization.
- Stochastic or continuous-time slack bounds (those remain out of the prelude-only discrete Nat core).

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Stated for discrete steps. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision. · The model omits relations; what it omits it neither shows nor rules out.
